question: Which of the following BEST explains why universal adult suffrage was important in Caribbean history?
options: It gave all adults the right to vote regardless of race or class moving the Caribbean toward true democracy
It only benefited wealthy citizens
It had no impact on Caribbean politics
None of the above

question: A line graph showing tourist arrivals over ten years is MOST useful for
options: Showing trends and changes in tourism over time
Showing the proportion of tourists from different countries
Comparing amounts at one point in time
None of the above

question: A pie chart showing sources of government revenue is MOST useful for
options: Showing what proportion of revenue comes from each source such as taxes and tourism
Showing how revenue has changed over time
Comparing revenue of different countries
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a NEGATIVE impact of large-scale tourism on a Caribbean island?
options: Pressure on water supplies, beaches and reefs and high economic leakage when profits go to foreign companies
More jobs for all citizens
Lower cost of living for residents
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes what economic leakage means in Caribbean tourism?
options: When a large portion of tourism earnings leaves the country because hotels and services are foreign-owned
When tourists spend too little money
When tourist numbers decline
None of the above

question: Which of the following is an example of a Caribbean country using its natural resources sustainably?
options: Managing fisheries carefully to prevent overfishing and allow stocks to recover
Catching all available fish as quickly as possible
Cutting all remaining forests for farmland
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains the importance of the Caribbean Sea to the region?
options: It supports fishing, tourism, trade routes and the livelihoods of millions of Caribbean people
It is only important for swimming
It is only used by large cargo ships
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a way in which families can conserve energy at home?
options: Turning off lights and appliances when not in use and using energy-efficient bulbs
Leaving all appliances on all day
Using more air conditioning
None of the above

question: Which of the following describes the difference between a democracy and a dictatorship?
options: In a democracy citizens elect their leaders; in a dictatorship one person rules with unchecked power
They are the same form of government
A dictatorship is more fair than a democracy
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains why Caribbean nations need to prepare for natural disasters?
options: Because the Caribbean is vulnerable to hurricanes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes and flooding which can devastate communities
Because natural disasters never cause serious damage in the Caribbean
Because the Caribbean only experiences mild weather events
None of the above

question: Which of the following is an example of how the government of SVG promotes cultural heritage?
options: Supporting Nine Mornings celebrations, Vincy Mas carnival and cultural education in schools
By banning all foreign cultural influences
Only through sports events
None of the above

question: Which of the following is the BEST description of what the Caribbean Single Market means for workers?
options: Skilled Caribbean nationals can move and work freely in other CARICOM member states
Only professionals can move between countries
Only businesspeople benefit from the Single Market
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a way in which climate change affects Caribbean water resources?
options: More droughts in some areas and more flooding in others making water supply less reliable
Climate change always increases fresh water availability
The Caribbean has no water shortage concerns
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes what the informal economy is?
options: Economic activities like street vending that are not registered or taxed by the government
The government-run sector of the economy
Large businesses that operate informally
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a way in which young people can contribute to their Caribbean community?
options: Volunteering, participating in civic activities, respecting the environment and staying in school
Only by earning money
Only after becoming adults
None of the above
